recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, high-contrast composition featuring a large ensemble cast at the bottom, anchored by a massive, overlapping yellow title and a central white directional signpost against a bright cyan gradient background.
coreVisualRelationships: Oversized title text dominates the upper two-thirds, acting as a frame for the cast.
The cast is arranged in a horizontal line at the bottom, creating a solid base.
A vertical signpost breaks the horizontal cast line and points toward the title.
Bright yellow and cyan create a high-energy, pop-aesthetic color contrast.
coreInvariants: Bright cyan background with a subtle central radial glow.
Ensemble cast positioned at the bottom edge.
Directional signpost graphic integrated into the mid-ground.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The ensemble cast occupies the bottom 30% of the frame; the title occupies the top 70%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large 'g' in the title acts as a massive left-side anchor, while the signpost provides a central vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large yellow title, move down the signpost to the cast, and then scan horizontally across the characters.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Cyan negative space is concentrated in the upper corners and around the signpost.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan (background) providing a cool, energetic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Yellow (title) for maximum visibility and pop appeal.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White (signpost and secondary text) for clarity and structure.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with high value contrast between the yellow text and cyan background.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight kerning with significant character overlap.
Lowercase letters for the main title with thick, uniform stroke weights.
Secondary text follows the curve of the primary letterforms.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'g' has a large, circular descender that acts as a frame.
The 'l', 'e', and 'e' are tightly packed, sharing vertical space.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A massive, stylized geometric display face paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Multi-directional signpost with black text on white arrows.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, circular nature of the display text.
Provides the necessary weight and geometric simplicity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a bright cyan background with a subtle radial white glow in the center. At the bottom, place a diverse ensemble cast of young adults in casual and school-themed clothing, standing and sitting with luggage. In the center-right, place a white wooden signpost with multiple arrows pointing in different directions.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a massive yellow lowercase sans-serif title in the upper two-thirds, with letters overlapping tightly. Add secondary white text in a smaller sans-serif font following the top curve of the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the background a vibrant cyan gradient?
Is the cast positioned at the bottom edge?
Is the signpost integrated into the composition?

mustAchieve: High-key studio lighting on the cast

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is readable against the cyan.
Check that the signpost doesn't obscure faces.
Verify the ensemble looks like a cohesive group.
Confirm the 'g' descender creates a strong visual frame on the left.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble cast at bottom + massive overlapping geometric title + vibrant gradient background + central graphic device (signpost).
